title: Less AI-sounding Skills briefs
reader_summary: After Claude writes a Skills blurb, apply a light polish that strips common AI-writing tells without changing facts.
outcome_line: Kept. Treatment rubric 13/13 pass with why now 5.0 and specificity 5.0 vs baseline 3.7 and 4.5; DIGEST_HUMANIZER_POLISH stays on both digests.
how_we_measure: Editorial rubric (specificity, why-now, accuracy) plus a short human-sounding spot-check. Token log is secondary (expect a small cost bump). Do not gate on PostHog CTR.

reader_glossary.meaning: A Claude Code skill (blader/humanizer) that detects named AI-writing patterns and rewrites prose without inventing facts. We did not install it. We copied the habit: one post-narration polish pass on Skills blurbs to strip filler and stock phrases while keeping README-grounded facts intact.

hypothesis: A post-narration Humanizer-style polish reduces AI-writing tells on Skills blurbs without hurting factual accuracy or Why-now hooks.
change_summary: Add DIGEST_HUMANIZER_POLISH=1 on both the OSS and Skills digest commands (post-narrate polish pass).
verdict: Baseline (13 Skills token log runs through 2026-10-09, polish off): mean 1622 output tokens and 999 words per run; rank 1 rubric 13 of 13 pass; why now avg 3.7 of 5; specificity avg 4.5 of 5; accuracy avg 4.0 of 5; estimated USD 1.16. Treatment (13 Skills runs through 2026-10-23, polish on; 2026-10-24 digest not published at close): mean 3620 output tokens and 1020 words per run; rubric 13 of 13 pass; why now avg 5.0 of 5; specificity avg 5.0 of 5; accuracy avg 4.0 of 5; estimated USD 1.64 (secondary). Spot check on Skills digest.json blurbs: treatment lines cite concrete HN thread points and named tools more often than baseline star velocity phrasing. Keep DIGEST_HUMANIZER_POLISH on both OSS and Skills digest commands.
notes: Closed 2026-10-24 PT. Token metrics from data/quality/token-usage.jsonl joined with data/quality/rubric-scores.jsonl (Skills single variant runs only; same method as baseline export). Frozen exports: data/experiments/exports/EXP-20260913-humanizer-polish-skills-{baseline,treatment}.csv. Humanizer polish kept on both digests in digest.yml. Lab post: briefings/lab/posts/EXP-20260913-humanizer-polish-skills.md.
